## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Refactor

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] Quickstart checked, if relevant
- [ ] Documentation updated, if relevant

## Security checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, cookies, private keys, or `.env` files are committed.
- [ ] No raw `Authorization`, `Cookie`, `Set-Cookie`, API keys, JWTs, or private keys are logged.
- [ ] Sensitive query strings or payload fields are redacted before diagnostics.
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior is covered by tests or documented.

## Notes for reviewers

Mention anything that needs special review attention.
